name: stol-sweep
note: The sustained shape on the fourth ONE-LAW airframe. deriveAzRate asks for the same FRACTION of structural g on a trainer as on a jet, so this is directly comparable to fixedwing-sweep in normalized terms (turnRateDemandRatio, terminalOffDeg/demand) and to nothing in absolute deg/s. Distinct tag from turn360 on purpose: compare-runs.py pools by tag alone. AIRFRAME: low-limit STOL trainer (alphaLimiter ~10 deg). A jet placed at 90 m/s will mush - see cards/README.md.
